heading: Relevancy of statements in maps, charts and plans.
text: Statements of facts in issue or relevant facts, made in published maps or charts generally offered for public sale, or in maps or plans made under the authority of [3][the Central Government or any State Government], as to matters usually represented or stated in such maps, charts or plans, are themselves relevant facts.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by the A.O. 1948, for “any Government in British India”.
